summary: Discussion-shard signals weighted toward vendor agent updates, open-source harness activity, operator pain reports (memory/indexing, MCP), and emerging security/compliance topics. | Vendor-only pass: product launches (Anthropic Opus 5, Mistral Vibe/Studio, Cloudflare Agents Week), infra updates (Cloudflare MCP, Modal sandboxes, Daytona), and operator guides (JetBrains, AWS S3 Files). Prioritize monitoring docs, SDKs, pricing, and community reports. | GitHub-only snapshot: multiple vendor releases (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Vercel, Langfuse, Mem0, ElizaOS) plus emerging infra primitives for MCP, agent runtime, and agent security. No social/operator field reports in this shard; single-repo items need corroboration before promotion. | Package-sourced snapshot: many new MCP/memory/eval primitives and several mainstream vendor agent CLIs (OpenAI, GitHub, OpenAI VS Code extension). High churn in agent runtime, eval, and memory packages; a few security-risk items (undetectable headless) and many single-source PyPI/npm crates needing corroboration.
